title: Falls and pressure care
summary: How falls and pressure damage are prevented, spotted early and followed up in people’s own homes.
whenToUse: Every quarter, after a fall with injury or a new pressure ulcer, or when falls incidents rise.

statements.focus: Falls and skin integrity risk assessments, repositioning and equipment use in the care plan.
Trip hazards, lighting and equipment such as hoists and pressure-relieving mattresses checked.
Skin checks at visits and what carers record and report.
Referrals to district nurses, falls teams and occupational therapists, and their advice followed.
Falls and pressure ulcers recorded as incidents, reviewed and learned from (and notified when grade 3 or 4).
